t: This sculpture is called Since 9/11, by Miya Ando. She's an American visual artist whose paintings, sculptures and installations explore time, interdependence and impermanence. Her work has been shown in museums, galleries and public spaces around the world. She's also the author of Water of the Sky, a dictionary of two thousand Japanese rain words. I don't have more detail about this particular piece, so take a moment with it, and think about how those ideas of impermanence might speak through its form and its title.
